title: Senior Frontend Developer
description: Senior frontend engineer and technical leader responsible for architectural design, performance engineering, complex meta-framework/RSC implementations, monorepo tooling, quality standards, and defensive web security.

skills.rationale: Leading bundle optimization, multi-layer caching, runtime performance (Web Workers/virtualization), and developer-side security architecture.
Mastery of Virtual DOM/Fiber reconciliation internals, headless design patterns, and high-performance component architecture.
Architecting React Server Components (RSC) boundaries, edge runtime deployments, and full-stack frontend infrastructure.
Designing complex mapped/conditional types, declaration files, and type-level APIs for shared libraries and design systems.
Architecting monorepo pipelines (Turborepo/Nx), Webpack Module Federation for micro-frontends, and automated CI/CD release engineering.
Designing visual regression pipelines, setting strategic coverage thresholds, and gating pull requests on automated performance budgets.
Deep expertise in iterators, Proxy reactivity engines, and diagnosing complex memory leaks in large SPAs.
Architecting design system styling methodologies (CSS Modules, Tailwind, ITCSS) and adopting modern features like container queries.
Architecting offline-first PWAs with Service Workers, IndexedDB storage management, and advanced browser observer APIs.

scoring.description: Each skill score is multiplied by its importance weight. Final score is sum divided by sum of weights.

not_ready.label: Not Ready
not_ready.description: Significant gaps in senior frontend architecture, performance engineering, or modern full-stack frontend patterns.

developing.label: Developing
developing.description: Solid mid-level execution, but lacks the architectural depth, monorepo leadership, or performance optimization experience expected of a senior.

approaching.label: Approaching Ready
approaching.description: Strong technical capabilities across most areas; refining expertise in RSC architecture, micro-frontends, and performance budgets.

ready.label: Ready
ready.description: Meets all senior expectations: designs robust frontend systems, mentors teams, enforces high quality gates, and solves hard performance challenges.

exceeds.label: Exceeds Expectations
exceeds.description: Exceeds senior expectations: staff/principal level impact in frontend platform architecture and cross-team developer tooling.
